prompt: Sort these sentences about our old cat in Tartu: Reality or Inside-out?

items.text: When the doorbell rings, the cat hides under the sofa.
If a visitor comes in, she will stay under there.
When we open a tin of fish, she runs straight into the kitchen.
If she were braver, she would greet our guests.
I wish she liked meeting new people.
If we lived on a quiet farm, she would sit by the door.

explanation_ru: Предложения группы Reality описывают реальные привычки и возможные планы (Present Simple, will). Группа Inside-out — воображаемые ситуации и желания (Past Simple после if и wish, would).

prompt: Grandfather Tor wants his grandson to help in the kitchen in Bydgoszcz. He makes a real promise about his family bread recipe.
options: If you will help me bake, I give you my bread recipe.
If you help me bake, I will give you my bread recipe.
If you helped me bake, I would give you my bread recipe.
If you had helped me bake, I would have given you my bread recipe.
explanation_ru: Дедушка даёт реальное обещание на будущее, поэтому нужен First Conditional: Present Simple после if и will в главной части. После if глагол will не ставится.

prompt: Your rabbit will get ill if you ___ him too many sweet treats.
options: will give
give
gave
would give
explanation_ru: Это реальное предупреждение о будущем (First Conditional). В части с if нужен Present Simple (give), а не will или would.

prompt: In a small pot, pasta always (to stick) together if you (not / to stir) it.
explanation_ru: Речь идёт о постоянном кулинарном факте (Zero Conditional), поэтому в обеих частях используется Present Simple: sticks и don't stir.

prompt: The corner bakery in Poznan makes the best sweet buns. If you (to come) after ten, the trays are always empty. I promised my sister fresh buns on Sunday, so if I wake up early, I (to bring) two warm ones home. I wish I (to live) closer to that street.
explanation_ru: Первый пропуск — регулярный факт (Zero Conditional: come). Второй — реальное обещание на воскресенье (First Conditional: will bring). Третий — нереальное желание о настоящем после wish (Past Simple: lived).

prompt: Bartek is looking at the messy playground in Derry. He wants to make a real deal with the children before the bell rings.
options: If you tidied the toy box, I would read you a story.
If you will tidy the toy box, I will read you a story.
If you tidy the toy box, I will read you a story.
If you had tidied the toy box, I would have read you a story.
explanation_ru: Ситуация реальна и относится к ближайшему будущему, поэтому нужен First Conditional: Present Simple после if (tidy) и will в главной части (will read).

prompt: Mehdi can hold the last board game if you will call before six.
answer: Mehdi can hold the last board game if you call before six.
accepted_answers: Mehdi can hold the last board game if you call before six.
explanation_ru: После союза if в реальном условии о будущем (First Conditional) нельзя ставить will — нужен Present Simple (if you call).

prompt: Put these sentences from the fruit market in Ghent into two groups: Real or Unreal.

items.text: When light rain starts, the fruit sellers cover their tables.
If the wind gets stronger, we will tie down the plastic sheet.
Unless it stops raining soon, fewer shoppers will walk past.
If this square had a roof, our boxes would stay dry.
We wouldn't need big coats if the market were indoors.
I wish we had a dry indoor stall.

explanation_ru: В группе Real — реальные привычки и возможные события (Present Simple, will). В группе Unreal — воображаемые условия и желания, которые не соответствуют действительности (Past Simple после if и wish, would).

prompt: I'm not sure about the cafe's hours. ___ the kitchen is closed, we'll eat at home.
options: When
Unless
If
Because
explanation_ru: Говорящий не уверен, закрыта ли кухня, поэтому событие лишь возможное — нужен союз if. Союз when используют для уверенных событий, а unless меняет смысл на противоположный.

prompt: Heavy rain is falling on our football pitch in Inverness. Our coach says we will cancel the match if the grass (to stay) too wet. We don't have a roof over the pitch. If we (to have) one, the grass (not / to get) so wet.
explanation_ru: Первое условие реальное (First Conditional), поэтому после if нужен Present Simple — stays. Во второй части ситуация воображаемая, так как крыши нет (Second Conditional): Past Simple (had) и wouldn't get.

prompt: Classify these sentences from Saeed's newsroom in Coimbra: Zero, First, or Second conditional?

items.text: When the morning meeting approaches, the office coffee machine always runs out of milk.
Whenever nobody refills the fridge, the editors drink black coffee.
If Saeed stops by the corner shop on his way in, he will bring two cartons.
Unless someone buys milk before nine, the interns will complain again.
If the newsroom had a bigger budget, we would order milk deliveries.
Saeed wouldn't look so grumpy if he had his usual latte.

explanation_ru: Zero Conditional (Present Simple + Present Simple) описывает регулярные привычки офиса. First Conditional (Present Simple + will) — реальные планы и предупреждения. Second Conditional (Past Simple + would) — воображаемые ситуации в настоящем.

prompt: Neda is making a concrete deal with her cafe manager in Santander about the coming term. Which sentence states her real offer correctly?
options: I would work the holidays if you gave me the early shift all term.
I will work the holidays if you will give me the early shift all term.
I will work the holidays when you will give me the early shift all term.
I will work the holidays if you give me the early shift all term.
explanation_ru: Это реальная договорённость на будущее, поэтому нужен First Conditional: will work в главной части и Present Simple (give) после if. Вариант с will после if — частая ошибка, а Second Conditional сделал бы предложение маловероятным.

prompt: Safety rules from a cookery class in Dundee.
sentences: Hot oil spits dangerously if even a drop of water falls into the pan.
Always dry your hands properly before you pick up a spoon near the stove.
If you will splash water into the frying pan, you will burn your fingers.
Unless you turn the heat down right away, the kitchen will fill with smoke.
If I were you, I would stand back slightly when adding the onions.

fixes.2: If you splash water into the frying pan, you will burn your fingers.

explanation_ru: В предложении 3 допущена типичная ошибка: после if в реальном условии о будущем (First Conditional) нельзя ставить will. Правильно: If you splash water...

prompt: What happens if a student ___ their printed card to the exam hall in Nicosia?
options: forgets
will forget
forgot
would forget
explanation_ru: Вопрос касается постоянного правила экзамена (What happens — Present Simple), поэтому это Zero Conditional. После if также нужен Present Simple (forgets), без will, would или прошедшего времени.

prompt: If Isha had bought a loaf before her late shift started, she wouldn't have gone home empty-handed.
options: Isha bought a loaf before her shift and went home empty-handed.
Isha didn't buy a loaf before her shift and went home empty-handed.
Isha didn't buy a loaf before her shift, so she still has bread at home.
Isha never buys bread before her late shift, so she always goes home without it.
explanation_ru: Third Conditional описывает нереальное прошлое с противоположным смыслом: «если бы купила, не ушла бы с пустыми руками» означает, что в реальности она не купила хлеб и ушла домой с пустыми руками.

prompt: Astrid bakes country loaves in her farm kitchen in Burgundy. Her dough always (to rise) faster when the morning air is warm and damp. On Tuesday a cold breeze blew through the open window, so the batch came out flat. If she (to close) the window in time, the bread would have turned out soft. Astrid wishes the old kitchen (to have) better heating for winter baking.
explanation_ru: Первый пропуск — постоянный факт (Zero Conditional: rises). Второй описывает нереальное прошлое во вторник (Third Conditional: had closed). В последнем после wish о настоящем ставится Past Simple (had).

prompt: Decide which time and world each sentence from Varun's hotel in Sharjah describes.

items.text: When checkout begins, the cleaners always start on the top floor.
If the guests in Room 504 leave early, we will prepare their suite first.
If the lift worked faster, the staff would finish the top floor in half an hour.
Varun wishes he didn't have to answer three phones at once.
If the tour bus had arrived on schedule, the lobby wouldn't have been so crowded.
We would have offered you a sea-view room if you had booked a week earlier.

explanation_ru: Реальные правила и планы выражены через Present Simple и will. Нереальное настоящее — через Past Simple (worked, didn't have) и would + инфинитив. Нереальное прошлое — через Past Perfect (had arrived, had booked) и would have + V3.

prompt: It is Wednesday morning at the dental clinic in Vigo. The dentist sees only emergency patients on Wednesdays, and your tooth feels completely fine.
options: If I would have an emergency, the dentist would see me today.
When I have an emergency, the dentist will see me today.
If I had an emergency, the dentist would see me today.
If I had had an emergency, the dentist would have seen me today.
explanation_ru: Сейчас среда, но экстренной ситуации у вас нет — это воображаемое условие в настоящем (Second Conditional): Past Simple после if (had) и would в главной части. После if нельзя ставить would, а when и Third Conditional здесь не подходят.

prompt: Notes after calling the vaccination centre in Oviedo.
sentences: The nurse told me to arrive before four o'clock.
If I will get stuck in traffic, the doors will be shut.
Unless I leave the office by three, I won't reach the clinic in time.
If I would live closer to the centre, I could walk there in ten minutes.
When you miss a slot there, you have to book a different week.

fixes.1: If I get stuck in traffic, the doors will be shut.
fixes.3: If I lived closer to the centre, I could walk there in ten minutes.

explanation_ru: В предложении 2 лишний глагол will после if (нужен Present Simple: If I get stuck). В предложении 4 — типичная ошибка «если бы → if + would» (правильно: If I lived closer).

prompt: A: Why didn't you revise in the Verona school library? B: I missed the notice! If I (to read) it, I (not / to pack) my books so early.
explanation_ru: Речь идёт о прошлом, которое уже не изменить (объявление не прочитали, книги уже собрали), поэтому нужен Third Conditional: had read и wouldn't have packed.

prompt: Jovan says the shared drive locks at six; if it would stay open longer, we could finish comfortably.
answer: Jovan says the shared drive locks at six; if it stayed open longer, we could finish comfortably.
accepted_answers: Jovan says the shared drive locks at six; if it stayed open longer, we could finish comfortably.
explanation_ru: Русское «если бы» нельзя переводить как if + would: в Second Conditional после if нужен Past Simple (if it stayed), а would/could стоит только в главной части.

prompt: We met a park ranger on a steep path in the Julian Alps. "These rocks always (to freeze) quickly when the sun drops," he warned. "If you (to keep) climbing after dark, you will slip on the ice." We took his advice and turned back straight away. If we (not / to listen) to him, we would have been stuck on the cold slope.
explanation_ru: Первый пропуск — регулярное природное явление (Zero Conditional: freeze). Второй — реальное предупреждение о будущем после if (First Conditional: keep, без will). Третий — нереальное прошлое (Third Conditional: hadn't listened).

prompt: Nobody follows the kitchen memo in our Aarhus office. What ___ if the manager locked the kettle away?
options: will happen
would happen
happens
would have happened
explanation_ru: В условии стоит Past Simple (locked) — это воображаемая ситуация в настоящем (Second Conditional), поэтому в вопросе нужен глагол would happen.

prompt: If Nicole hadn't accepted the steady post at the Budapest music academy years ago, she wouldn't still be teaching first-year students now.
options: Nicole turned down the steady post years ago and no longer teaches first-year students.
Nicole accepted the steady post years ago, so she stopped teaching first-year students.
Nicole accepted the steady post years ago, and she still teaches first-year students.
Nicole didn't accept the steady post years ago, yet she still teaches first-year students.
explanation_ru: Это смешанное условие (Mixed Conditional): прошлое условие (hadn't accepted) и результат в настоящем (wouldn't still be teaching). В реальности полярность обратная: она приняла должность и до сих пор преподаёт первокурсникам.

prompt: Eoghan turned down a noisy city job five years ago and chose to drive the coastal airport shuttle in Costa Rica instead. If he (to take) that stressful office job, he (not / to be) nearly as calm and happy now. Whenever a flight (to land) late at night, he waits patiently outside arrivals with a flask of coffee. His friends in the capital often say they wish they (to make) the same bold move when they had the chance.
explanation_ru: Первые два пропуска образуют Mixed Conditional (нереальное прошлое решение → результат сейчас: had taken, wouldn't be). В третьем — регулярная привычка после whenever (lands). В четвёртом — сожаление о прошлом после wish (Past Perfect: had made).

prompt: Joao's old flat in the northern city wouldn't be standing empty now if he hadn't moved to sunny Cascais for the weather.
options: Joao moved to Cascais, so his old flat in the northern city stands empty now.
Joao didn't move to Cascais, so his old flat in the northern city stands empty now.
Joao moved to Cascais, and someone else is living in his old flat now.
Joao wants to move to Cascais, so he left his old flat empty.
explanation_ru: Смешанное условие (wouldn't be standing empty now + if he hadn't moved) означает, что в реальности Жуан переехал в Кашкайш, и поэтому его старая квартира сейчас пустует.

prompt: Edward worked part-time while studying in Basel, so today he holds a university degree and has healthy savings in the bank. Which sentence correctly imagines the opposite?
options: If Edward hadn't studied part-time in Basel, he wouldn't have had both a degree and savings now.
If Edward didn't study part-time in Basel, he wouldn't have both a degree and savings now.
If Edward wouldn't have studied part-time in Basel, he wouldn't have both a degree and savings now.
If Edward hadn't studied part-time in Basel, he wouldn't have both a degree and savings now.
explanation_ru: Решение относится к прошлому (нужен Past Perfect: hadn't studied), а результат — к настоящему (now → wouldn't have, без have + V3). Это Mixed Conditional; остальные варианты содержат ошибки во времени или лишний would после if.

prompt: An email from Harry at the mountain lodge in Salzburg.
sentences: Guests are welcome on the terrace as long as the mountain wind stays calm.
If the gusts pick up this evening, we will lock the glass doors straight away.
Last weekend a storm hit suddenly, and if the hikers would have stayed outside, someone might have got hurt.
I wish the weather forecast were more reliable up here in the Alps.
We would definitely keep the terrace open year-round if the winters here aren't so fierce.

fixes.2: Last weekend a storm hit suddenly, and if the hikers had stayed outside, someone might have got hurt.
fixes.4: We would definitely keep the terrace open year-round if the winters here weren't so fierce.

explanation_ru: В предложении 3 ошибка в Third Conditional: после if нельзя ставить would have (правильно: if the hikers had stayed). В предложении 5 воображаемое условие в настоящем (Second Conditional) требует Past Simple после if: weren't вместо aren't.

prompt: The new technician in Mallow is usually careless about warnings. Yesterday he switched off the backup server mid-update, and the whole system crashed.
options: If the technician were more careful, he wouldn't have switched off the backup server during the update.
If the technician were more careful, he wouldn't switch off the backup server during yesterday's update.
If the technician had been more careful, he wouldn't switch off the backup server yesterday.
If the technician would be more careful, he wouldn't have switched off the backup server during the update.
explanation_ru: Постоянная черта в настоящем (он невнимателен вообще → Second Conditional: If he were more careful) повлияла на событие в прошлом (вчера он отключил сервер → Third Conditional: wouldn't have switched off).

prompt: Group these sentences from the Snowdonia campsite guide by their conditional logic.

items.text: The night walk will go ahead only if the wind drops below the safe limit.
When thick mist rolls over the valley, we always cancel the ridge trail.
If the campers had brought spare batteries, their torches wouldn't have died on the hill.
If I were leading a group of beginners tonight, I would choose the lower lakeside path.
If the guide weren't so cautious by nature, he would have let the group climb in last night's storm.
If we had cancelled the walk an hour earlier, everyone wouldn't still be drying their boots now.

explanation_ru: В группе Real condition — реальные правила и возможные события (Present Simple, will). В Unreal (single time) обе части относятся к одному времени (чистый 2-й или 3-й тип). В Mixed (two times) условие и результат лежат в разных временах.

prompt: A student's message after the final exam in Bruges.
sentences: Our lecturer warned us all term that the exam would be tough if we skipped revision.
I missed the last two sessions because I thought I knew the material well enough.
If I attended those revision classes last week, I would have answered the final essay question easily.
I wish I had listened to her warning instead of leaving everything to the final evening.
Next term I won't miss a single seminar, even if the timetable is packed.

fixes.2: If I had attended those revision classes last week, I would have answered the final essay question easily.

explanation_ru: В предложении 3 речь идёт о завершённом прошлом (last week), поэтому в условии нужен Third Conditional с Past Perfect (If I had attended), а не Past Simple из второго типа.

prompt: In the campus office in Manama, the printer room always (to run) out of paper right before exam week. Baptiste forgot that rule and arrived ten minutes before his deadline with nothing printed. If he (to print) his report two evenings earlier, he (not / to panic) in the corridor. He has promised himself that if the campus trays are empty on Monday, he (to walk) straight to a print shop in town.
explanation_ru: Первый пропуск — регулярная ситуация (Zero Conditional: runs). Второй и третий — нереальное прошлое (Third Conditional: had printed, wouldn't have panicked). Четвёртый — реальный план на конкретное будущее (First Conditional: will walk).
